public_rationale: The January 31, 2024 Bloomberg report neither highlights the fourfold formulation comparison nor discusses the linked Esvelt-lab paper [e3]. The February 1 Verge report does not identify the fourfold comparison, although it discusses other benefits from model access and questions OpenAI's framing [e4]. These articles establish omissions in those reports, but cannot establish the broader claim about OpenAI and contemporary media through February 4, 2024 [e3][e4].
limitations: The supplied evidence items omit OpenAI's publication and do not provide a sufficiently comprehensive contemporary media record.
